crossRefs.note: Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,
they came near to Zerubbabel, and to the heads of fathers’ households, and said to them, “Let us build with you; for we…
Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot.
Assyria can’t save us. We won’t ride on horses; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, ‘Our gods!’ for…

people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.
